_comment: SET 2 LEGENDARIES — 'Cloud of Witnesses'. 30 collectible legendaries + 15 Fulfilled forms. Same schema as cards.seed.json. Human source: docs/18-legendary-set-2.md (rail math, law checks, memo). Tone: epic on the board, funny in the margins, reverent at the core.

_newCapabilities.deal_enemyHero: Face damage (Joel). Planned to land with this set — human sign-off noted in docs/18.
_newCapabilities.costReduce_classFilter: costReduce with class:'prophet' filter (Shunammite Woman). Config-level extension.

cards.name: Joshua, the High Priest
cards.text: Endure. Fulfill: survive damage.
cards.flavor: The prosecution had a whole case prepared. Then came the wardrobe change. — Zechariah 3.
cards.art: A priest in soiled robes standing in a court of light as clean garments descend, defiant hope.

cards.name: Joshua, Clothed in White
cards.text: Endure. Your other units have +0/+1.
cards.flavor: Objection overruled. Permanently.
cards.art: A radiant high priest in clean white garments, the courtroom shadows retreating.

cards.name: Jehoiada, the Kingmaker
cards.text: Arrival: give an ally Guard and Endure.
cards.flavor: Hid the rightful king in the temple for six years. Patience is a weapon. — 2 Kings 11.
cards.art: An old priest drawing a curtain over a small crowned child, temple shadows.

cards.name: Bezalel, Spirit-Gifted
cards.text: Arrival: draw 2 Relics from your deck. Your Relics cost (1) less.
cards.flavor: The first person Scripture calls 'filled with the Spirit of God.' His ministry: craftsmanship. — Exodus 31.
cards.art: An artisan at a workbench, tabernacle fittings glowing softly, wood shavings like gold.

cards.name: Hezekiah, the Sick King
cards.text: Guard. Fulfill: your hero has taken damage.
cards.flavor: Told to set his house in order. Filed an appeal instead. — 2 Kings 20.
cards.art: A king turned to the wall in prayer, dawn light entering the chamber.

cards.name: Hezekiah, Granted Fifteen Years
cards.text: Guard. At the start of your turn, restore 2 to your hero.
cards.flavor: Got fifteen more years and immediately showed Babylon the treasury. Kings, man. — 2 Kings 20.
cards.art: A king on a sunlit balcony, the shadow on the steps moving backward.

cards.name: Nehemiah, Rebuilder of the Walls
cards.text: Arrival: Raise two fallen allies; give them Guard.
cards.flavor: Surveyed the ruins at night, said 'let us rise and build,' and half the city grabbed trowels. — Nehemiah 2.
cards.art: A governor on a night ride among broken walls, torch aloft, workers rising.

cards.name: Miriam, Sister at the Riverbank
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 2. Fulfill: cast 2 spells.
cards.flavor: Posted lookout over a floating basket. Best babysitting in recorded history. — Exodus 2.
cards.art: A girl half-hidden in reeds watching a basket drift, dawn teal.

cards.name: Miriam, Prophetess of the Song
cards.text: At the end of your turn, restore 1 to all allies.
cards.flavor: Grabbed a tambourine and led the first singalong in recorded history. — Exodus 15.
cards.art: A woman mid-dance with a tambourine, the sea behind her, joy unleashed.

cards.name: John the Baptist
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 3. The next unit you play costs (2) less.
cards.flavor: Camel hair. Locusts. Wild honey. Zero indoor voice. — Matthew 3.
cards.art: A wild-haired preacher mid-proclamation at the Jordan's edge, crowds on the far bank.

cards.name: Huldah the Prophetess
cards.text: Arrival: Discover a spell from your deck; it costs (2) less.
cards.flavor: Five officials, including the high priest, went to ask her if the scroll was real. It was. — 2 Kings 22.
cards.art: A seated scholar-prophetess authenticating a scroll before anxious officials, lamplight.

cards.name: Habakkuk, on the Watchtower
cards.text: At the end of your turn, Foresee 1. Fulfill: cast 3 spells.
cards.flavor: Climbed the tower, filed his complaint, and waited for the reply. — Habakkuk 2.
cards.art: A cloaked prophet atop a night watchtower, city below, stars.

cards.name: Habakkuk, the Answered
cards.text: Your spells cost (1) less.
cards.flavor: 'The righteous shall live by faith.' Worth the wait. — Habakkuk 2.
cards.art: The same prophet at dawn, writing the answer on tablets big enough to read at a run.

cards.name: Joel, Herald of the Day
cards.text: Arrival: deal 3 to the enemy hero and restore 3 to your hero.
cards.flavor: The locusts took everything. He promised it back with interest. — Joel 2.
cards.art: A prophet at dawn over a stripped field turning green at the edges.

cards.name: Judah, the Pledge
cards.text: Guard. Fulfill: survive damage.
cards.flavor: 'Let me remain as your slave in place of the boy.' Growth arc of the millennium. — Genesis 44.
cards.art: A rough brother stepping in front of the youngest, palace hall, guarded stance.

cards.name: Judah, the Lion's Line
cards.text: Guard. Covenant: give your other units +1/+0.
cards.flavor: The scepter shall not depart. — Genesis 49.
cards.art: A patriarch beneath a lion banner, brothers rallying behind him, gold dawn.

cards.name: Leah, the Unloved
cards.text: Legacy: summon a 1/1 Heir. Fulfill: control 3+ other allies.
cards.flavor: The other sister got the poem. She got the dynasty. — Genesis 29.
cards.art: A veiled woman with steady eyes, small sons at her skirts, tent dawn.

cards.name: Leah, Mother of Kings
cards.text: Covenant: summon a 1/1 Heir.
cards.flavor: Judah and Levi were hers: the crown and the priesthood. Take that, poetry. — Genesis 35.
cards.art: A matriarch beneath a family tree of light, crown and censer among its branches.

cards.name: Rebekah, at the Well
cards.text: Arrival: Discover a unit from your deck.
cards.flavor: Watered ten camels voluntarily — roughly 250 gallons — then said yes to everything. — Genesis 24.
cards.art: A young woman hauling a jar at a stone well, camels kneeling in a queue, dusk gold.

cards.name: Seth, the Appointed
cards.text: Covenant: gain +1/+1.
cards.flavor: Third son. And then people began to call on the name of the LORD. Slow starts count. — Genesis 4.
cards.art: A young man tending a small first altar at the edge of Eden's wilds, big sky.

cards.name: Ephraim & Manasseh, the Crossed Blessing
cards.text: Arrival: give your other units +2/+2.
cards.flavor: Jacob crossed his hands on purpose. Joseph objected. Jacob had been the younger brother too. — Genesis 48.
cards.art: An old patriarch's crossed hands on two boys' heads, Joseph protesting mid-frame.

cards.name: Gideon, Threshing in Secret
cards.text: Fulfill: win a fight while outnumbered.
cards.flavor: Threshing wheat in a winepress, which is not where wheat goes. The angel called him a mighty warrior anyway. — Judges 6.
cards.art: A nervous farmer threshing grain in a sunken winepress, glancing over his shoulder.

cards.name: Gideon, Mighty Man of Valor
cards.text: Your units have +1 attack while the enemy has more units than you.
cards.flavor: Three hundred men, torches, jars, and a lot of shouting. — Judges 7.
cards.art: A commander raising a torch and a shattered jar on a midnight hillside, camp in panic below.

cards.name: Barak, the Reluctant
cards.text: Can't attack while it's your only unit. Fulfill: control 2+ other allies.
cards.flavor: 'If you go with me, I will go.' The prophetess went. The credit, famously, did not. — Judges 4.
cards.art: A general checking over his shoulder for Deborah before charging, storm over Tabor.

cards.name: Barak, Lightning of Kedesh
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: His name literally means lightning. He finally lived up to the branding. — Judges 4.
cards.art: The same general at full charge downhill, storm breaking behind him.

cards.name: Jael, of the Tent
cards.text: Arrival: destroy a damaged enemy unit.
cards.flavor: Milk, a rug, and the most decisive use of camping equipment in Scripture. — Judges 5.
cards.art: A woman at a tent door offering a bowl of milk, mallet just visible at her belt.

cards.name: Caleb, of Another Spirit
cards.text: Endure. Fulfill: your hero has taken damage.
cards.flavor: Forty years of walking in circles. Attitude: intact. — Numbers 14.
cards.art: A weathered scout among grumblers, arms crossed, eyes on the horizon.

cards.name: Caleb, Give Me This Mountain
cards.text: Giant-Slayer.
cards.flavor: Eighty-five years old. Requested the mountain with the giants on it. On purpose. — Joshua 14.
cards.art: A silver-bearded warrior pointing up at a fortified hill, grinning.

cards.name: Jesse of Bethlehem
cards.text: Arrival: summon a 1/1 Sheep. Fulfill: control 3+ other allies.
cards.flavor: Eight sons. Seven had great résumés. — 1 Samuel 16.
cards.art: A sturdy farmer counting sons filing past a gate, one conspicuously missing.

cards.name: Jesse, Father of the Anointed
cards.text: At the start of your turn, summon a 1/1 Sheep.
cards.flavor: Bethlehem's whole thing started here. Ask Ruth. — Ruth 4.
cards.art: A proud patriarch at his gate, fields of sheep rolling to the horizon.

cards.name: Mephibosheth, at the Table
cards.text: While you control a David, this has +2/+0 and Guard.
cards.flavor: Lame in both feet, summoned to the palace, expecting the worst. Got a permanent dinner invitation. — 2 Samuel 9.
cards.art: A man with a crutch seated at a royal table, dumbfounded, warm hall.

cards.name: Nathan's Ewe Lamb
cards.text: Legacy: give your units +1/+0.
cards.flavor: It ate from his plate and slept in his arms. You monster. — 2 Samuel 12.
cards.art: A small lamb curled by a poor man's fire, one bowl, one cup.

cards.name: Mary of Magdala
cards.text: Endure. Fulfill: survive damage.
cards.flavor: Seven demons. Then none. She never went home. — Luke 8.
cards.art: A resolute woman with a coin purse among the traveling company, dawn road.

cards.name: Mary, the Devoted
cards.text: At the end of your turn, give another random friendly Disciple +1/+1.
cards.flavor: Bankrolled the whole mission out of her own purse. Receipts available. — Luke 8.
cards.art: A steady patron handing out provisions at a campfire, ledger tucked under one arm.

cards.name: James & John, Sons of Thunder
cards.text: Swift. Scatter: summon two 1/1 Disciples.
cards.flavor: Asked permission to call down fire on a village. Request denied. Nickname approved. — Luke 9.
cards.art: Two storm-faced fishermen brothers mid-argument, clouds boiling behind them.

cards.name: John Mark, the Deserter
cards.text: The first time this would die, return it to your hand instead. Fulfill: survive damage.
cards.flavor: Left the mission trip early. Paul kept receipts. — Acts 13.
cards.art: A young man speed-walking away from a docked ship, sandals in hand.

cards.name: Mark, Useful for Ministry
cards.text: Legacy: draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: 'Get Mark. He is useful to me.' Redemption arcs make the best résumés. — 2 Timothy 4.
cards.art: A focused scribe writing fast by lamplight, pages stacking up.

cards.name: Esther, in the Palace
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 1. Fulfill: your hero has taken damage.
cards.flavor: New name, new address, old secret. — Esther 2.
cards.art: A young queen at a latticed window, palace opulence, watchful eyes.

cards.name: Queen Esther, For Such a Time
cards.text: Guard. Legacy: give your units +2/+2.
cards.flavor: 'If I perish, I perish.' Spoiler: she didn't. — Esther 4.
cards.art: A queen at the throne-room threshold, scepter extending toward her, breath held.

cards.name: Mordecai, at the King's Gate
cards.text: Guard. Fulfill: your hero has taken damage.
cards.flavor: Refused to bow. Sat at the gate. Overheard everything. — Esther 3.
cards.art: A bearded man seated immovably at a palace gate as officials sweep past.

cards.name: Mordecai the Great
cards.text: Guard. Your other units have +1/+0.
cards.flavor: Second to the king — wearing the robe Haman ordered for himself. — Esther 10.
cards.art: A dignified elder in royal robes on a white horse, a furious official leading it.

cards.name: Rahab, of the Scarlet Cord
cards.text: Endure. Fulfill: survive damage.
cards.flavor: Wrong address, right window. — Joshua 2.
cards.art: A woman tying a scarlet cord at a window in a city wall, dust of a marching army below.

cards.name: Rahab, Grafted In
cards.text: Endure. Legacy: draw a card.
cards.flavor: Innkeeper of Jericho; great-great-grandmother of David. Check the genealogy. — Matthew 1.
cards.art: The same woman at a family table generations deep, a scarlet thread woven through the tablecloth.

cards.name: The Shunammite Woman
cards.text: Your Prophet cards cost (1) less.
cards.flavor: Built the prophet a rooftop room: bed, table, chair, lamp. Five-star hospitality, ninth century BC. — 2 Kings 4.
cards.art: A well-to-do woman showing a furnished rooftop room, pride and welcome.

cards.name: Cornelius the Centurion
cards.text: Arrival: restore 3 to your hero and draw a card.
cards.flavor: A Roman officer so generous even the angels took notes. — Acts 10.
cards.art: A centurion distributing bread at his door, soldiers queueing awkwardly behind.
